nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the broader goal of this research within the context of environmental governance?
nodes.answer: The broader goal is to achieve equitable environmental governance in a rapidly changing global context.
nodes.paragraph: This research contributes to the field by addressing a critical gap: the intersection of socioeconomic inequalities and environmental behavior across a global landscape. While existing studies have largely focused on high-income countries, this study expands the analysis to include developing nations, where socioeconomic disparities are more pro- nounced and the urgency for effective environmental policies is heightened. By providing a Wealth, Wisdom, and the Will to Protect: An Examination of comprehensive examination of the role of SES in shaping environmental perceptions, this study enhances the theoretical understanding of environmental behavior. It offers practical pathways for crafting more inclusive sustainability strategies that address the needs of mar - ginalized populations. In doing so, it contributes to the broader goal of achieving equitable environmental governance in a rapidly changing global context. The remainder of this paper is structured as follows: Sect. 2 reviews the relevant litera- ture on socioeconomic factors influencing environmental perceptions and pro-environmen- tal behavior. Section 3 outlines the methodology employed in this study, including data sources, variables, and analytical techniques. Section 4 presents the key findings of the analysis, followed by a detailed discussion in Sect.
